beats.say: Artificial intelligence can copy a person's voice from a short recording, sometimes only a few seconds long.
A scammer calls in the voice of your boss or a relative and urgently asks for money, a code or a document.
The number can be faked too. The name and number on your screen are not proof.
Agree on a secret check word with your family and your team. A fake voice will not know it.

nodes.text: Hi, I am in a meeting and cannot talk long. We must urgently transfer 18,000 manat to a contractor. Tell no one, I will explain later.
nodes.speaker: Kamran Babayev's voice
nodes.spoken: Hi, <breath> I am in a meeting and cannot talk long. We must urgently transfer 18,000 manat to a contractor. Tell no one, uh, I will explain later.

choices.label: Do it right away
choices.feedback: The money went to a scammer. Urgency plus secrecy is the strongest warning sign.

choices.label: Ask for the check word
choices.feedback: Good idea. Let us see how he answers.

choices.label: Say I will call him back myself
choices.feedback: Right. Call a number you already know.

nodes.text: What word? I have no time! Don't you recognise me?
nodes.speaker: Kamran Babayev's voice
nodes.spoken: What word? I have no time! <short pause> Don't you recognise me?

choices.label: Apologise and transfer
choices.feedback: Pressure is the scammer's main tool. A real boss understands a check.

choices.label: Hang up and call back myself
Report it to the security team
choices.feedback: Well done. They will warn your colleagues too.

choices.label: Tell no one, no money was lost
choices.feedback: The scammer will try someone else. Reporting protects everyone.

scenes.prompt: Find the warning signs in this chat.

body.text: My phone broke, this is my new number.
It's me, Elvin. Can you hear me? I am in trouble, I urgently need your help.

messages.spoken: It's me, Elvin. <breath> Can you hear me? I am in trouble, I urgently need your help.

body.text: Please don't tell anyone at home.
Send it to this card, it's my friend's.

spots.label: New number
spots.explain: The new number story stops you from calling the old number to check.

spots.label: Voice message
spots.explain: The voice may sound familiar and still be fake. A short recording is enough to copy it.

spots.label: Urgent money
spots.explain: An urgent request for money is the core sign of a scam.

spots.label: Secrecy
spots.explain: Asking you to tell no one is meant to stop you checking.

spots.label: Someone else's card
spots.explain: The money goes to someone else's card. That hides the trail.

scenes.title: An evening call
scenes.intro: An unknown number calls in the evening. The voice sounds very familiar. What do you do?

actions.label: Answer
actions.feedback: Answering is not dangerous. What matters is what you do next.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: That is fine too. If you are worried, call your relative yourself on the number you know.

steps.say: Hello, it's me, Narmin! There was an accident and the police are holding me. I need 900 manat now, don't tell the family!
steps.spoken: Hello, <breath> it's me, Narmin! There was an accident and the police are, uh, holding me. I need 900 manat now, <breath> don't tell the family!

actions.label: Where do I send it?
actions.feedback: Agreeing at once is exactly what the scammer needs. Check first.

actions.label: What is our code word?
actions.feedback: Right. A cloned voice will not know the word you agreed on.

actions.label: Hang up and call back myself
actions.feedback: Correct. Call Narmin on the old number you know.

steps.say: What word? I'm crying and you ask about a word! The police are waiting, hurry!
steps.spoken: What word? <breath> I'm crying and you ask about a word! The police are waiting, <breath> hurry!

actions.label: Fine, I am sending the money
actions.feedback: The money went to a scammer. Tears and rush are there to make you skip the check.

actions.label: Hang up
actions.feedback: Right. No code word, no conversation.

steps.label: The call has ended. What now?

actions.label: Call Narmin's old number
actions.feedback: Right: Narmin is at home and nothing happened. Warn the family too.

actions.label: Do nothing
actions.feedback: The scammer may call again or try another relative. Tell the family.

scenes.prompt: Put the steps after a suspicious call in order.

items.label: Call the number in your contacts yourself
Ask whether the request is real
Report it to the security team

scenes.explain: The proof is not on the screen. It is in the second call that you start yourself.

scenes.prompt: Match each trick with the right response.

pairs.left: Urgent transfer in the boss's voice
pairs.right: Call back on a known number
Call the old number to check

pairs.left: A familiar face on a video call
A request to keep it secret

scenes.explain: Every trick has a simple check. Make it a habit.

question.prompt: On a video call, the director asks you to send a confidential report to a personal email. What do you do?

options.label: Send it, I can see him on screen
options.feedback: The image can be fake. A face is not proof.

options.label: Get separate confirmation through an official channel
options.feedback: Correct. Confidential files go only through official channels, after confirmation.

options.label: Ask him to wave his hand in front of the camera
options.feedback: It may trip up some fakes, but it is not a reliable check.

scenes.explain: However real it looks, check an unusual request through another channel.

points: A familiar voice, face or number is not proof.
Hang up and call back on a number you know.
Agree on a check word with family and team.
